title: Water system development fee based on daily use
summary: On June 5, 2026, a budget amendment aligned the Water Supply water fund section with the proposed Bill 76 changes, and the water system development fee changes take effect July 1, 2026. Bill 76 bases the fee on average daily demand, not meter size, and was set for second and final reading that day. Properties already legally connected would not pay again, and future budgets plan 2 to 3 percent yearly increases.

timeline.text: Refer Bill 76, water system development fee: The chair recommended sending Bill 76, on the water system development fee, to a water committee.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Cut $500,000 from the wastewater operations B account and reduce bond funding for a wastewater pump station project by $500,000: The committee approved the change.
